headings.title: Lien for labor or material on animals with written memorandum
headings.reviewNote: Covers lien entitlement for persons furnishing labor or material on a horse, mule, or other animal upon obtaining a signed written memorandum.

headings.title: Possession requirement and optional aggregate lien on multiple animals
headings.reviewNote: Covers requirement that animal be placed in claimant's possession and option to assert aggregate lien across multiple animals of the same owner.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text (RSMo 1939 § 3609): written-memorandum lien on animals and possession requirement with optional aggregate lien across multiple animals.

headings.title: Prohibition against taking property without consent or payment
headings.reviewNote: Covers prohibition against taking lien-subject vehicle, aircraft, or animal from custody without consent or payment of lawful charges.

headings.title: Validity against purchasers with notice and subordination to perfected liens
headings.reviewNote: Covers validity against purchasers with notice and subordination to prior perfected financing statement liens absent secured party consent.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text (including 1957 Mack Motor Truck Corp. case annotation on artisan liens vs. storage charges): custody retention and priority relative to purchasers with notice and prior perfected financing statements.

headings.title: Lien creation, duration, and aircraft recording requirements
headings.reviewNote: Covers possessory lien creation on written request for labor, materials, or storage of vehicles, vessels, or aircraft, and county and FAA recording to preserve aircraft liens.

headings.title: Application for certificate of ownership after forty-five days
headings.reviewNote: Covers application to director of revenue for certificate of ownership or title if chattel remains unredeemed after forty-five days.

headings.title: Notice requirements for unredeemed storage or towing chattels
headings.reviewNote: Covers thirty-day certified mail notice requirements to owner and lienholders of record before applying for lien title on unredeemed storage or towing chattels.

headings.title: Required contents and fee for lien title application
headings.reviewNote: Covers required written request copy, affidavit of notice, statement of actual value and unpaid amount, and ten-dollar application fee.

headings.title: Director examination and issuance of lien title
headings.reviewNote: Covers director of revenue review of application and certified mail proof and issuance of repossessed-style certificate of ownership captioned Lien Title.

headings.title: Timeframe to commence sale proceedings after receiving lien title
headings.reviewNote: Covers requirement that lienholder begin sale proceedings under section 430.100 within ten days of receiving lien title.

headings.title: Proceeds disposition and recovery of expenses and attorney fees
headings.reviewNote: Covers application of section 430.110 to sale proceeds and entitlement to recover necessary expenses, court costs, and reasonable attorney fees.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 7 subsections against archived text: possessory liens on vehicles, trailers, vessels, outboard motors, and aircraft, 180-day county/FAA aircraft recording, 45-day redemption and 30-day certified mail notice, lien title issuance, 10-day sale commencement, and proceeds/fee recovery.

headings.title: Notice by registered mail and publication or handbills
headings.reviewNote: Requires at least 20 days advance notice by registered mail (if address is known) and either two newspaper publications or five township handbills if no county newspaper exists.

headings.title: Statutory form for notice of sale
headings.reviewNote: Covers required statutory form and contents for notice of sale enforcing liens for labor, services, skill, or material.

headings.title: Combined publication for multiple liens
headings.reviewNote: Covers authorization to combine notices for multiple liens into a single publication rather than publishing separately.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text including embedded notice form; tightened subsection 1 title to reflect conjunctive registered-mail and publication/handbill notice requirements.

headings.title: Sale of unredeemed chattels and distribution of proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Permits sale of unredeemed chattels under section 430.100 and sets three-tier distribution to seller lien/advertising, perfected prior financing-statement liens, and county or St. Louis city treasurer; original-rolls footnote notes word "same" for "sale".

headings.title: Deposit crediting, owner reclamation, and three-year limitation
headings.reviewNote: Covers crediting of excess proceeds to general revenue and owner's right to reclaim funds within three years upon proof and commission or comptroller order.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text including original-rolls footnote ("same" for "sale" in subsection 1): chattel sale, proceeds distribution order, and 3-year owner reclamation window.

headings.title: Placement of impounded animals with humane society or designee
headings.reviewNote: Covers placement of lawfully impounded animals by impounding officers in the care of incorporated humane societies or designated responsible persons.

headings.title: Lien for reasonable cost of caring for impounded animals
headings.reviewNote: Covers entitlement of humane societies or designated caretakers to liens for reasonable care costs under sections 430.150 and 430.160.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: permissive placement of lawfully impounded animals with humane societies or designees and resulting lien for reasonable care costs under sections 430.150 and 430.160.

headings.title: Definitions for health practitioner and institutional liens
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory definitions for claim, clinic, health practitioner, insurance carrier, other institution, and patient.

headings.title: Extension of hospital lien rights to clinics and health practitioners
headings.reviewNote: Covers extension of hospital lien rights under sections 430.230 to 430.250 to clinics, health practitioners, and other qualifying institutions.

headings.title: Fifty-percent cap on net proceeds and proportional sharing among lienholders
headings.reviewNote: Covers limitation of health provider liens to fifty percent of net recovery proceeds and proportional sharing among lienholders.

headings.title: Direct payment of lien amounts by insurance carriers
headings.reviewNote: Covers authorization for insurance carriers to pay secured lien amounts directly upon claimant authorization absent charge or causation challenges.

headings.title: Release of claimant liability upon election to receive benefits
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory release of claimant from further liability for services and treatment upon provider election to receive lien benefits.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections against archived text: definitions for sections 430.225 to 430.250, extension of hospital lien rights, 50% net-proceeds cap and proportional sharing, permissive direct insurer payment, and claimant liability release.

headings.title: Preferred wage payment priority and enforcement by civil action
headings.reviewNote: Covers corporate obligation and priority of payment for employee wages up to one hundred dollars earned within three months, enforceable by civil action.

headings.title: Monthly wage payment schedule and six percent interest on delinquency
headings.reviewNote: Covers monthly wage payment deadline on or before the fifteenth day and addition of six percent interest on unpaid wages.

headings.title: Priority over unsecured corporate debts in receivership or assignment
headings.reviewNote: Covers wage debt priority from corporate assets held by officers, agents, receivers, or assignees over other unsecured claims.

headings.title: Liability for damages caused by unlawful withholding of priority wages
headings.reviewNote: Covers corporate officer, agent, receiver, or assignee liability for damages caused by refusing to recognize wage claim priority.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections against archived text (including cross-reference to sections 513.055 to 513.065): corporate employee wage priority up to $100 within 3 months, monthly payment schedule with 6% interest, receivership/assignment priority, and withholding liability.

headings.title: Disposition of excess sale proceeds and deficiency judgments
headings.reviewNote: Covers payment of excess sale proceeds to customer and prior lienholder and entitlement to deficiency judgment if proceeds are insufficient.

headings.title: Compliance with patent and copyright law and satisfaction order
headings.reviewNote: Covers prohibition against sales violating federal patent or copyright rights and judicial orders requiring debt satisfaction prior to mold release.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: excess proceeds and deficiency judgment on plastic fabricator lien sales, federal patent/copyright bar, and permissive judicial order for debt satisfaction before mold release.
